common_rules: in_cnt and q_cnt are at least the block's inputs.min / outputs.min, and at most its max.
Every required input is wired (not VM_BLOCK_NO_ID).
custom_len is at least the state size.

value_kinds.bool: Read as true when non-zero / written 1 or 0. Any scalar object.
value_kinds.u8: Read or written as an unsigned 8-bit number. Any scalar object (converted).
value_kinds.u32: Read or written as an unsigned 32-bit number. Any scalar object (converted).
value_kinds.i32: Read or written as a signed 32-bit number. Any scalar object (converted).
value_kinds.f32: Read or written as a float. Any scalar object (converted).
value_kinds.scalar: Read in its own type; the block's behaviour depends on it (see the block). B, U8, U32, I32 or F.
value_kinds.gate: Written 1 while active and cleared quietly (0 without marking it updated) otherwise: wire it to enables.
value_kinds.object: A whole object or tree; source and destination must have the same types and counts.
value_kinds.ptr-cell: An element of a PTR object; the block hangs its own tree there.

activation_kinds.enabled: Runs every pass while its enables allow it (always, with no enables); resets or clears its outputs when disabled.
activation_kinds.triggered: Runs when an input it watches is fresh (marked updated this pass) and it is enabled.
activation_kinds.enable-rising: Runs once each time its enables turn it on.
